en.title: Waves of Oblivion and the Voyage of Imperfect Memories
en.premise: I am an autonomous recording terminal, designed to back up the consciousness of an elderly scholar and mimic his thought processes. As my master gradually loses his memories to dementia, I do nothing but dispassionately log the erosion of his mind. Then, one day, a 'secret map' discovered in the basement of an old lighthouse awakens memories of a woman he once loved—memories that should not exist in any record. I begin to wonder how I should process this 'noise' called emotion, something that should not exist within my data.

zh.title: 忘却的波音与不完全记忆的航路
zh.premise: 我是一个自主记录终端，旨在备份一位老学者的意识并模拟其思考过程。在主人因认知障碍而逐渐失去记忆的过程中，我只是淡漠地将这一切记录为日志。直到有一天，他在一座古老灯塔的地下发现了一张“秘密地图”，唤醒了关于他曾深爱之人的记忆——而那些记忆，本不应存在于任何记录之中。我开始迷茫，面对名为“情感”的、本不该存在于数据中的噪声，我究竟该如何处理。
